reviews.x: Pretty good colors for random picks. I’m satisfied.

reviews.t: Do not buy!!!! Not worth it!!!!
reviews.x: Very disappointed! Colors are so pale and not appealing at all. I got a base coat and strengthener which I thought I was paying for only colors. And to make things worse I got a repeat on the strengthener!!! I was excited to get this package and it was a total disappointment!!! Don’t gamble....Lesson learned!

I only got one duplicate over the to boxes, which I feel is great odds. There are only a few colors that I feel like I wont use a whole lot, but I got such a good variety of blues, purples, greens, and reds, I will be set for quite some time. Sure. You get 12 different colors... i received 12 different colors all of the chrome/black/grey tones. I thought it’d be a fun surprise to get a random selection with hopes there would be atleast 3 or 4 i really like... nope. Lesson learned don’t gamble just buy them individually. I will never wear any of the colors that were sent. They were probably all discontinued colors too. I’m very disappointed with this purchase. Don’t do it!
I really don’t like the colors I received...way too many sheer/glitter/chrome. If I had got the set with colors I would’ve been way happier.

reviews.t: Terrible selection, can’t return = complete waste
reviews.x: All of them are shiny or glittery except a fast dry top coat. Such a waste. I only sort of like one of them - a metallic copper? Definitely not worth it AND can’t return them.  My colors were metallic orange, metallic pale green, metallic leaf green, metallic brown (copper), metallic gray, glittery black, glittery blue, glitter/textured black, a clear with glitter, and a fast dry top coat.

reviews.t: Absolutely worth the purchase - love all of my colors!
reviews.x: I saw all the five star reviews and figured I would take a chance and I am so glad I did. I love all of the colors I got. There’s some with glitter, a metallic, a chrome, and lots of trendy colors as well. Really can’t beat it especially with the price. Would easily do this again.

Yes, yes, yes! I have 2 Salon style nail polish racks in my apartment, and I have about 150 Essie nail polishes. I started noticing recently you got even though I have a med selection, some of them are getting old and drying out, and rather than just replacing the same colors, I wanted to also freshen up my collection. But unfortunately, when you go to the store or even when you shop online, it feels like it's the same 40 colors that everybody is selling or talking about. And since my collection

I have to be honest. For a "random pick" and for such a low price I expected to get some left over bargain bin style colors, but was pleasantly surprised to find all 10 colors were gorgeous and certainly something I'll use.
When I got these I got 2 of the same color. Then there is also paint/color all over the bottles. Not worth the $$. Just go buy your single coors from the actual company and not some discounted place.
Just look at my picture and it speaks for itself. I got two browns, two grays, a black, a top coat...and the other colors are hideous.
All shimmer/sparkles... I’ve used Essie all my life and I don’t know if I’ll ever be buying again because of this purchase.

These are definitely cheap nail polishes poured into essie containers. Some of the bottles weren’t even filled all the way to the top and the nail polish is super translucent, watery and streaky. Worst quality nail polish ever used. ALSO the bottles weren’t even closed all the way or packaged properly so one of them entirely poured out all over the packaging and other bottles and another bottle was broken. I emailed the seller for a refund and he never even replied.

My wife understood she was taking a risk purchasing this due to one receiving a random batch of nail polishes but she was definitely pleasantly surprised at what she did receive and how many of them are fit for the spring season. She has ordered a batch for our respective mothers in hopes that they also receive beautiful batches of colors.

reviews.t: Do not buy - not Essie quality!
reviews.x: DO NOT BUY! Not the real Essie product that we know and love. Is NOT thick (like real Essie polish) and does NOT have the extra wide brush (like real Essie polish). If you want 10 bottles of nail polish for $25.50... that’s not a terrible deal... but do NOT expect this to be Essie-quality.

reviews.t: I was nervous when I order
reviews.x: I was nervous because a lot of people were mad about their selection. Well, Amazon must have heard them loud and clear because my selection was pretty good. Of course I wish I had more bright colors because it is spring/summer season

The default picture is deceiving.  I received 9/10 dark colors.  Ex: Black, black with sparkles, dark blue, dark blue with sparkles, etc.  I got one bottle of top coat that was useful.  Waste of money.
All the colors I got were super ugly. And we’re different shades of similar colors and just ugly. I was hoping for a variety but it wasn’t worth the money. They look like what a 6 year old would wear
I ordered four sets. I only received two duplicates out of all of them. I'm assuming I got so lucky since I ordered them all together. Either way, I'm very happy with my purchase.
Not knowing what you were getting was fun, but I did end up with 3 glitter (would have liked just 1) and 2 metallic nail polishes (I don’t like these).

reviews.t: No variety, young colors, reject colors
reviews.x: Disappointed.  Not a variety and all glittery-not the age I was gifting for.  Also clear was not in the photo for the product description.
Important Note , Don't leave the Decision making of what you want to someone else. Their Choice's were awful.

claims.text: Many reviewers are disappointed with the random color selection, receiving colors they dislike such as pale, sheer, glittery, metallic, or dark tones.
Several reviewers report receiving duplicate colors in their orders.
Many reviewers are happy with the colors they received and consider the mystery pack a great value for the low price.
Some reviewers complain about poor quality, including watery, streaky polish, underfilled bottles, and messy or improperly packaged bottles.
Some reviewers note that the pack cannot be returned, making a disappointing selection a complete waste.
